the only available package namespace for now is
, the package browser on the web, is effectively just a mirror of this GitHub repo.
Submitting a new package is therefore as simple as opening a Pull Request.
Create a new branch on the locally cloned fork
Create and push a new commit
Open a Pull Request on the upstream packages repo
That’s it. After filling out the PR description, your job is to wait for approval. There is
